// how: Groups in the Spaces sidebar. A space goes to the first group whose folder pattern
matches where it is (its first terminal's folder). `~/x/**`: x and everything under it;
`~/x/*`: x's direct subfolders; anything else: that folder only.
Folders you make with a space's right-click menu come after these; a space you move
there stays there, whatever the rules say. Spaces that match nothing go to Other.
